pages.text: In a field B a nucleus precesses at the Larmor frequency f = γB/2π (protons 42.58 MHz per tesla, carbon-13 10.71). A radio pulse at exactly that frequency tips it; listening, the chemical surroundings shift it by parts per million. The magnet is superconducting: too warm, or too much field, and it quenches.
$(thing)Set$(): Magnetic field, Radio frequency.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Field drift: B varies by ±0.0001%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The magnet is not superconducting (too warm); The field is over the magnet's rating: it quenches.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A stronger field reads more clearly, and faster.
